{"consolidated_memory":"## Route Shadowing in api/gateway/router.go — Two Separate Incidents

**Component:** api/gateway/router.go (API gateway side)
**Stack:** Go
**Test coverage:** api/gateway/router_test.go
**Common symptom:** Route shadowing causing wrong handler name in request spans
**Common repro:** Curl the two overlapping prefixes in order

### Incident 1: March 13, 2026
**Triggered by:** Clients still pinned to v1 SDK
**Root cause:** Serialiser dropping unknown fields
**Fix:** Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
**PR:** #3743 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1
**Measured outcome:** Memory settled at 755 MB (previously climbing past 9 GB)

### Incident 2: July 31, 2026
**Triggered by:** First request after cold start
**Root cause:** Schema drift between migration and model
**Fix:** Regenerated model from migration and pinned the checksum
**PR:** #4674 on branch fix/route-shadowing-2
**Measured outcome:** Throughput rose 56 percent to 919 requests per second"}
